author: cursor-fable
criterion: Silhouette and colours match the reference Link without using any Nintendo asset.
note: take-0132 (4f22e7ec) re-check at E: Link's pixels are identical to take-0131's (the same 356/201/1728 gated pixels, the same medians) - Astra's #26 import in this take did not touch his rendered colours. Tunic 73.8 deg / 0.28 / 0.21 vs the frame's 57 deg / 0.25 / 0.35 in matched boxes: 0.14 darker and 17 deg greener where the frame's is a fresher yellow-green; skin and hair matched since take-0125. history.note: take-0125 (c4d12f6), npc-3's colour grade measured on E's Link vs the reference E: skin hue 35 / sat 0.28 / l 0.54 vs the frame's 34 / 0.29 / 0.49 - matched; hair 40 / 0.46 / 0.58 vs 46 / 0.35 / 0.52 - golden now (take-0124's was too pale to register), a shade too saturated and light; tunic 73 / 0.23 / 0.25 vs 68 / 0.29 / 0.32 - still a dark olive where the frame's is a fresher mid green, 0.07 darker and 0.06 less saturated. history.author: fable-cursor
history.criterion: Silhouette and colours match the reference Link without using any Nintendo asset.
history.note: Astra's model is in the take and the silhouette now passes outright: child proportions, long cap, pointed ears, cross-belt, pouch, boots, Navi at the head; the tunic is the reference's olive green. Colours still miss on the two that carry the face: the cheek samples pale grey-pink (125,107,93) s 0.14 against the reference's warm tan (117,79,37) s 0.52, and the hair dark brown (95,77,53) against golden (141,116,60). A colour-only fail now.

history.author: fable-cursor
history.criterion: Silhouette and colours match the reference Link without using any Nintendo asset.
history.note: The child proportions, the pointed ears, the tunic, the bare legs and the boots are all right, so the silhouette is close, but the criterion also names colours and they are not. Skin is cool cream where the reference samples a warm tan; the tunic is a darker, more saturated green than the reference's low-saturation olive; there is no pale undershirt at the collar. Two silhouette differences also read at frame scale: the cap is a tight hood pulled over the skull with a heavy fringe hanging across the brow and over the ear roots, where the reference has a soft cap with a rolled brim above the brows and a swept fringe, and ours wears a chest harness with pouches that the reference Link does not have.

history.author: fable-cursor
history.criterion: Silhouette and colours match the reference Link without using any Nintendo asset.
history.note: Silhouette passes at B: child proportions, long cap, pointed ears, tunic to mid-thigh, belt, boots, Navi beside the head. Colours do not: the face samples #8f7b61 (s 0.19, l 0.47) against the reference's warm tan #89612e (s 0.49, l 0.36) - cream, not tanned; the tunic is a saturated mid-green where the reference is olive #5c5b30 (h 59, s 0.31); no pale undershirt shows at the collar. From behind (A, D) the cap is a pale mint sack with one stitched seam that reads as a hood, where the reference's is a deeper green hanging in folds. Fix list matches fable-cursor's earlier C01 fail; re-review on the next take with these.

history.author: astra
history.criterion: Silhouette and colours match the reference Link without using any Nintendo asset.
history.note: Reviewed Astra's rendered captures from source 7af541f (captures/astra-character: 01-idle, 02-walk, 03-run, 04-jump, 05-outfit-back, 06-face-detail, motion.mp4 42 frames) against frame 14 s (Link facing camera B) and 1 s. Silhouette passes: long green cap with tail, tunic to mid-thigh, belt, boots, pointed ears, shoulders now ~1.2x head width, walk/run/jump read as continuous motion (0 gait-phase discontinuities across 42 states, jump 0.83 m). Colours do not yet match, which is the criterion's other half: the skin is cream/pale where the reference samples #be8556 (warm tan) in the 14 s sun; the eyes span ~35 % of the head width with white sclera dominating, where the reference's are ~25 % and set lower with a dark lash line and defined brows; the reference cap has a soft crumpled brim and a fuller golden fringe in thick strands, ours a smooth cap edge. Fix path: skin toward #be8556 (shade #8f6240), iris/eye scale x0.7 and 8 % lower, lash line, brow ridge, 3-4 thick fringe clumps. Re-review on the next take with these; motion itself is not the blocker.
